versions.subject: Rule: StickyKey-ike backdoor usage
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    ParentImage:
        - '*\winlogon.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - '*\cmd.exe sethc.exe *'
        - '*\cmd.exe utilman.exe *'
        - '*\cmd.exe osk.exe *'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 ParentImage="*\\winlogon.exe" CommandLine IN ("*\\cmd.exe sethc.exe *", "*\\cmd.exe utilman.exe *", "*\\cmd.exe osk.exe *")
